title: Looking for an Algo Trading Platform
author: lucifer_master_007
selftext:
Has anyone here actually used an algo trading platform in India and had a good experience with it?

I’m looking for something reliable for **intraday/automated trading**. Not looking for marketing claims or backtested results — I’d really appreciate **real user experience**.

If you personally use one, please share the platform name and what you like/dislike about it. 🙏

comments.author: avneetbindra
comments.body:
None, most of the famous ones are not good enough. 

If you know how to code, Try OpenAlgo with recently launched OpenScript for coding your own strategies and backtesting them. They even have an MCP integration to help vibe code strategies

comments.author: CuriousandQuite
comments.body: Not the algo trading actually but I had code in pine script for CoCH and BOS strategy.

comments.author: Mundane_Cicada_1427
comments.body:
I actually went the DIY route. I eventually stopped relying on algo platforms because I wanted full visibility into the data, strategy logic, execution, slippage, fees, etc. I built my own stack around broker APIs + local historical data + my own backtest/execution engine, so the same strategy logic can be tested and then deployed without depending on a platform's black-box implementation.

It's definitely more work upfront, but for me the biggest benefit is knowing exactly what the system is doing. If you're evaluating platforms, I'd look less at advertised backtest results and more at **data quality, execution reliability, API stability, slippage/fees modelling, and how much control you actually have over the code**.
